title: Quebec City: Old Quebec Highlights – 2‑Hour Guided E‑Bike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Short on time? Explore Quebec City’s highlights without the sweat. Avoid the exhaustion of slow walking tours—an electric bike helps you climb the city’s legendary hills. In just 120 minutes, I guide you through 400 years of history, from Place Royale to Château Frontenac and the Plains of Abraham. Maximize your time and experience the city in one fast, fun, unforgettable ride.⚠️ PHYSICAL REQUIREMENT: The e-bikes used for this tour are heavy and powerful. Operating them safely on steep, uneven streets and alongside city traffic requires excellent physical balance, active steering, and confidence. This tour is strictly not suitable for beginners or occasional riders who only cycle on flat paths. Recent cycling experience is mandatory for your own safety.
